title: 10 min from Broadway Townhome with Rooftop+Firepit
description:
Welcome to our centrally located townhouse in the heart of a peaceful neighborhood, just a short 10-15 minute drive away from the vibrant activities of Nashville! With keyless entry for your convenience, you can check in hassle free. 

Our townhouse is equipped with everything you need to make the most of your visit to Music City including;
• Fully stocked and equipped kitchen
• High speed wifi
• Washer/Dryer 
• Private rooftop
• Fireplace 
. Smart TVs

The space
- Sleeps 5
- 2 Bedrooms / 2 Full Bathrooms / 1 half Bath / 2 queen size beds on second floor / Sofa Bed on first floor
- Full Rooftop Deck 
- Free Parking

Guest access
There are two locked supply closets. Otherwise, please make yourself at home in the entire space 🌟

Other things to note
There is no one living on-site 24/7. If any problems arise, we will do our best to take action ASAP.
